Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly synthesized the data retrieved by the WebSurfer. In Step 3, the WebSurfer correctly identified the Battle of Peleliu dates as "15 September to 27 November 1944" based on the visible text in the search results. However, in Step 4, the Planner hallucinated the year as 1914 ("Peleliu: 15 September - 27 November 1914") instead of 1944. This factual error led to the incorrect conclusion that Peleliu occurred earlier than Belleau Wood (1918), reversing the actual historical chronology.
